A '''Mon Calamari pilot''' flew an [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This pilot was first revealed in a San Diego Comic Con [[2011]] teaser video promoting the deleted scenes included with the [[Star Wars: The Complete Saga|Blu-ray release]] of the six ''[[Star Wars]]'' films. The character is only seen for a moment, he is dressed in the same uniform as the A-wing pilots seen in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']].

[[File:Mon_Cal_Pilot_TVC_package.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The pilot in an A-wing at the Battle of Endor]]
The actual deleted material runs over two minutes and consists of someone off-screen telling the puppeteer what to "say" to the camera, and him repeating with the puppet.<ref name="Blu-Ray">{{HomeVideoCite|set=Star Wars: The Complete Saga|scene=Battle of Endor: Lost Rebels}}</ref>
The puppeteers are addressed as "Tim" and "Simon"; presumably [[Tim Rose]] and [[Simon Williamson]], who also portrayed [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] and [[Max Rebo/Legends|Max Rebo]], respectively.

This Mon Calamari pilot is wearing a green A-Wing flight suit, but is flying a B-Wing. The cockpit visible behind the puppet in the deleted scene is noticeably different from the A-Wing cockpits seen in the film.

[[Hasbro]] released an action figure of this character, named as "Rebel Pilot (Mon Calamari)", in February [[2012]] as part of [[Star Wars: The Vintage Collection|''The Vintage Collection'']] — part of the ''[[Star Wars Legends]]'' continuity. The card art shows him piloting an A-Wing, as consistent with his flight suit rather than what appeared on screen. The ''[[Rebel Starfighters Owners' Workshop Manual]]'' from [[2019]] finally named the pilot [[Ika Sulko]] and made him part of the current ''Star Wars'' canon.
